entries.zu: Qala uqinisekise ukuthi zingaki ezatshalwa ngokoqobo nokuthi nini. Bala eziphilayo uziqhathanise nalelo qoqo elatshalwa, hhayi izinto ezihlongozwe ebalazweni; bhala ezifakwe esikhundleni ngokwehlukana.
entries.st: Qala ka ho netefatsa hore ho jetswe tse kae ka nnete le neng. Bala tse phelang o di bapise le sehlopha seo se jetsweng, eseng dintho tse sisintsweng mmapeng; ngola tse kenang sebakeng sa tse shweleng ka thoko.
entries.ts: Rhanga u tiyisisa leswaku ku byariwe swingani hakunene ni leswaku rini. Hlayela swimilana leswi hanyaka eka ntlawa wolowo lowu byariweke, ku nga ri swilo leswi ringanyetiweke emepeni; rhekhoda leswi pfalaka leswin'wana hi ku hambana.
entries.ve: Thomani nga u khwaṱhisedza uri ho ṱavhiwa zwingana zwa vhukuma na uri lini. Vhalani zwimela zwi tshilaho ni zwi vhambedze na tshigwada tshenetsho tsho ṱavhiwaho, hu si zwo dzinginywaho kha mapa; ṅwalani zwo valaho zwiṅwe nga u fhambana.

entries.english: Measure the physical beds carrying a crop, counting each once. A saved crop plan is planned use, not confirmation of actual planting.
entries.zu: Linganisa imibhede engokoqobo enezitshalo, ubale ngamunye kanye. Uhlelo lwezitshalo olugciniwe luwukusetshenziswa okuhleliwe, alusikho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kutshalwe ngokoqobo.
entries.st: Lekanya dibethe tsa nnete tse nang le sejalo, o bale e nngwe le e nngwe hang feela. Moralo wa dijalo o bolokilweng ke tshebediso e rerilweng, ha o netefatse hore ho jetswe ka nnete.
entries.ts: Pima mibedo ya xiviri leyi nga ni xibyariwa, u hlayela wun'wana ni wun'wana kan'we. Pulani ya swibyariwa leyi hlayisiweke i matirhiselo lama kunguhatiweke, a hi xitiyisekiso xa ku byala ka xiviri.
entries.ve: Pimani mibethe ya vhukuma i re na tshiliṅwa, ni vhale muṅwe na muṅwe luthihi. Pulane ya zwiliṅwa yo vhulungwaho ndi u shumisa ho pulaniwaho, a i khwaṱhisedzi u ṱavhiwa ha vhukuma.

entries.english: Each indicator below is one this app can record, on a screen that already exists. An indicator nobody can capture is not a plan — it is a wish, and it is why most monitoring tables are empty a year later.
entries.zu: Inkomba ngayinye engezansi ingabhalwa kule app, esikrinini esikhona kakade. Inkomba engeke iqoshwe muntu ayilona uhlelo — iyisifiso, futhi yingakho amathebula amaningi okuqapha enganalutho ngemva konyaka.
entries.st: Letshwao ka leng le ka tlase le ka ngolwa ke app ena, skrineng se seng se le teng. Letshwao leo ho seng motho ya ka le rekotang ha se moralo — ke takatso, mme ke ka hoo ditafole tse ngata tsa ho beha leihlo di se nang letho selemo hamorao.
entries.ts: Xikombiso xin'wana ni xin'wana laha hansi xi nga rhekhodiwa hi app leyi, eka xikrini lexi se xi nga kona. Xikombiso lexi ku nga riki na munhu loyi a nga xi rhekhodaka a hi pulani — i ku navela, naswona hi swona leswi endlaka leswaku matafula yo tala yo landzelerisa ma nga vi na swona endzhaku ka lembe.
entries.ve: Tshisumbedzi tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe afho fhasi tshi nga ṅwalwa nga app iyi, kha tshikirini tshi re hone. Tshisumbedzi tshine ha vha hu si na ane a nga tshi ṅwala a si pulane — ndi nyemulo, nahone ndi ngazwo thebuḽu nnzhi dza u sedzulusa dzi tshi vha dzi si na tshithu nga murahu ha ṅwaha.

entries.english: Take baseline readings before support starts. Label any later or recalled starting figures clearly; compare matching periods and do not attribute every change to the project.
entries.zu: Thatha izilinganiso zesimo sokuqala ngaphambi kokuqala kosizo. Cacisa noma yiziphi izibalo zokuqala eziqoshwe kamuva noma ezikhunjulwayo; qhathanisa izikhathi ezifanayo futhi ungasho ukuthi lonke ushintsho ludalwe yiphrojekthi.
entries.st: Nka ditekanyo tsa motheo pele tshehetso e qala. Hlalosa ka ho hlaka dipalo tsa qalo tse nkilweng hamorao kapa tse hopotsweng; bapisa dinako tse tshwanang mme o se ke wa re phetoho e nngwe le e nngwe e bakilwe ke projeke.
entries.ts: Teka mimpimo yo sungula mpfuno wu nga si sungula. Fungha kahle tinhlayo to sungula leti tekiweke endzhaku kumbe leti tsundzukiwaka; ringanisa minkarhi leyi fanaka naswona u nga vuli leswaku ku cinca kun'wana ni kun'wana ku vangiwe hi phurojeke.
entries.ve: Tekani mbonalo dza u thoma musi thuso i sa athu thoma. Sumbedzani zwavhuḓi nomboro dza u thoma dzo ṅwalwaho nga murahu kana dzo humbulwaho; vhambedzani zwifhinga zwi fanaho ni si dzhie uri tshanduko iṅwe na iṅwe yo vhangwa nga thandela.

entries.english: Build storage before expanding planted area. Size the tanks against the roof catchment figure in the water section, and plant the dry months from stored water only.
entries.zu: Yakha indawo yokugcina amanzi ngaphambi kokwandisa indawo etshaliwe. Khetha usayizi wamathangi ngokwesibalo samanzi ophahla esigabeni samanzi, bese utshala ezinyangeni ezomile ngamanzi agciniwe kuphela.
entries.st: Haha polokelo ya metsi pele o atolosa sebaka se jetsweng. Lekanya boholo ba ditanka ho ya ka palo ya metsi a marulelo karolong ya metsi, mme o jale dikgweding tse ommeng ka metsi a bolokilweng feela.
entries.ts: Aka vuhlayiselo bya mati u nga si ndlandlamuxa ndhawu leyi byariweke. Pima mathangi hi ku ya hi nhlayo ya mati ya lwangu eka xiyenge xa mati, kutani u byala hi tin'hweti to oma hi mati lama hlayisiweke ntsena.
entries.ve: Fhaṱani vhugalelo ha maḓi musi ni sa athu engedza fhethu ho ṱavhiwaho. Khethani vhuhulwane ha thannga nga nomboro ya maḓi a ṱhanga kha khethekanyo ya maḓi, ni ṱavhe nga miṅwedzi yo omayo nga maḓi o vhulungwaho fhedzi.

entries.english: Roof runoff is lost — catchment traced but nothing to store it in
entries.zu: Amanzi agelezayo ophahla ayalahleka — uphahla ludwetshiwe kodwa akukho okuwugcina
entries.st: Metsi a phallang marulelong a a lahleha — sebaka sa ho a bokella se takilwe empa ha ho moo a bolokwang teng
entries.ts: Mati ya lwangu ma lahleka — ndhawu yo ma hlengeleta yi dirowiwile kambe a ku na xo ma hlayisela eka xona
entries.ve: Maḓi a elelaho a ṱhanga a a xela — fhethu ha u a kuvhanganya ho olwa fhedzi a hu na tsha u a vhulunga

entries.english: {area} m² of roof traced and 0 L of tank capacity on the plan
entries.zu: Uphahla olungu-{area} m² ludwetshiwe nomthamo wethangi ongu-0 L epulanini
entries.st: Marulelo a {area} m² a takilwe le bokgoni ba tanka ba 0 L moralong
entries.ts: Ku dirowiwe lwangu ra {area} m² ni vundzeni bya thangi bya 0 L eka pulani
entries.ve: Ho olwa ṱhanga ya {area} m² na vhungala ha thannga ha 0 L kha pulane

entries.english: Gutter the traced roof and connect it to a tank. This is the cheapest water on the site and it is currently running onto the ground.
entries.zu: Faka imisele yophahla oludwetshiwe uyixhume ethangini. Lawa amanzi ashibhe kakhulu endaweni futhi manje agelezela emhlabathini.
entries.st: Kenya digatara marulelong a takilweng mme o di hokele tankeng. Ana ke metsi a theko e tlase ka ho fetisisa sebakeng sena mme hajwale a phallela fatshe.
entries.ts: Veka tigatara eka lwangu leri dirowiweke kutani u ti hlanganisa ni thangi. Lawa hi wona mati yo chipa ngopfu endhawini naswona sweswi ma khulukela ehansi.
entries.ve: Vheani migero kha ṱhanga yo olwaho ni i ṱumanye na thannga. Aya ndi maḓi a mutengo wa fhasi u fhira oṱhe kha fhethu nahone zwino a khou elela mavuni.

entries.english: Storage cannot be planned — tank sizes are not recorded
entries.zu: Ukugcina amanzi akukwazi ukuhlelwa — osayizi bamathangi ababhalwanga
entries.st: Polokelo e ke ke ya rerwa — boholo ba ditanka ha bo a ngolwa
entries.ts: Vuhlayiselo a byi nge pulaniwi — vukulu bya mathangi a byi rhekhodiwanga
entries.ve: Vhugalelo a vhu nga pulaniwi — vhuhulwane ha thannga a ho ngo ṅwalwa

entries.st: Tanka e {count} moralong e se nang bokgoni bo boletsweng
entries.ts: Thangi ra {count} eka pulani leri nga vuriwangiki vundzeni bya rona
entries.ve: Thannga ya {count} kha pulane i si na vhungala ho bulwaho

entries.english: {count} tanks on the plan with no stated capacity
entries.zu: Amathangi angu-{count} epulanini angenamthamo obhaliwe
entries.st: Ditanka tse {count} moralong tse se nang bokgoni bo boletsweng
entries.ts: Mathangi ya {count} eka pulani lama nga vuriwangiki vundzeni bya wona
entries.ve: Thannga dza {count} kha pulane dzi si na vhungala ho bulwaho

entries.english: Measure or read the capacity off each tank and record it. Every dry-season calculation in this report depends on it.
entries.zu: Linganisa noma ufunde umthamo wethangi ngalinye bese uwubhala. Zonke izibalo zesikhathi esomile kulo mbiko zincike kuwo.
entries.st: Lekanya kapa o bale bokgoni tankeng ka nngwe mme o bo ngole. Palo e nngwe le e nngwe ya sehla se ommeng tlalehong ena e itshetlehile ka bona.
entries.ts: Pima kumbe u hlaya vundzeni bya thangi rin'wana ni rin'wana kutani u byi rhekhoda. Nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana ya nguva yo oma eka xiviko lexi yi titshege hi byona.
entries.ve: Pimani kana ni vhale vhungala kha thannga iṅwe na iṅwe ni vhu ṅwale. Mbalelo iṅwe na iṅwe ya khalanwaha yo omayo kha muvhigo uyu yo ḓitika ngaho.

entries.english: Soil loss from runoff on the slope
entries.zu: Ukulahleka komhlabathi ngenxa yamanzi agelezayo emthambekeni
entries.st: Ho lahleha ha mobu ka lebaka la metsi a phallang moepeng
entries.ts: Ku lahleka ka misava hi mati lama khulukaka eriweni
entries.ve: U xela ha mavu nga maḓi a elelaho kha mutsheṱo

entries.english: {slope}° slope, at or above the {threshold}° threshold
entries.zu: Ukwehla okungu-{slope}°, kufinyelela noma kudlule umkhawulo ongu-{threshold}°
entries.st: Moepa wa {slope}°, o fihlang kapa o fetang moedi wa {threshold}°
entries.ts: Ku rhelela ka {slope}°, eka kumbe ehenhla ka mpimo wa {threshold}°
entries.ve: Mutsheṱo wa {slope}°, u lingana kana u fhira mukano wa {threshold}°

entries.english: Keep the ground covered at all times, and put earthworks on contour above the growing area before breaking any more soil.
entries.zu: Gcina umhlabathi umboziwe ngaso sonke isikhathi, bese wenza imisebenzi yomhlabathi elandela imigqa yokuphakama okufanayo ngaphezu kwendawo yokutshala ngaphambi kokumba omunye umhlabathi.
entries.st: Boloka mobu o kwahetswe ka dinako tsohle, mme o etse mesebetsi ya mobu e latelang mela e lekanang ka bophahamo ka hodimo ho sebaka sa temo pele o epolla mobu o mong.
entries.ts: Hlayisa misava yi funengetiwile minkarhi hinkwaya, kutani u endla mitirho ya misava hi ku landza milayeni leyi nga eka ku tlakuka loku fanaka ehenhla ka ndhawu yo byala u nga si cela misava yin'wana.
entries.ve: Dzulani no tiba mavu tshifhinga tshoṱhe, ni vhee mishumo ya mavu kha mitalo i re kha vhuimo ha nṱha hu fanaho nṱha ha fhethu ha u ṱavha musi ni sa athu lima maṅwe mavu.

entries.english: Runoff carries water and topsoil off the growing area
entries.zu: Amanzi agelezayo asusa amanzi nomhlabathi ongaphezulu endaweni yokutshala
entries.st: Metsi a phallang a tlosa metsi le mobu o ka hodimo sebakeng sa temo
entries.ts: Mati lama khulukaka ma rhwala mati ni misava ya le henhla ma swi susa endhawini yo byala
entries.ve: Maḓi a elelaho a bvisa maḓi na mavu a nṱha kha fhethu ha u ṱavha

entries.english: {slope}° slope, between the {lower}° and {upper}° thresholds
entries.zu: Ukwehla okungu-{slope}°, phakathi kwemikhawulo engu-{lower}° no-{upper}°
entries.st: Moepa wa {slope}°, o pakeng tsa meedi ya {lower}° le {upper}°
entries.ts: Ku rhelela ka {slope}°, exikarhini ka mimpimo ya {lower}° na {upper}°
entries.ve: Mutsheṱo wa {slope}°, vhukati ha mikano ya {lower}° na {upper}°

entries.english: Mulch the beds and slow runoff on contour. Watch the ground after the first heavy rain and record where water actually runs.
entries.zu: Mboza imibhede ngezinsalela zezitshalo bese unciphisa ukugeleza kwamanzi ngokulandela ukuphakama okufanayo. Bheka umhlabathi ngemva kwemvula yokuqala enkulu bese ubhala ukuthi amanzi ageleza kuphi ngokoqobo.
entries.st: Kwahela dibethe ka dimela tse ommeng mme o fokotse phallo ya metsi ho latela mela e lekanang ka bophahamo. Sheba mobu ka mora pula ya pele e matla mme o ngole moo metsi a hlileng a phallang teng.
entries.ts: Funengeta mibedo hi masalela ya swimilana kutani u hunguta ku khuluka ka mati hi ku landza milayeni ya ku tlakuka loku ringanaka. Languta misava endzhaku ka mpfula yo sungula ya ntamu kutani u rhekhoda laha mati ma khulukaka kona hakunene.
entries.ve: Tibani mibethe nga masalela a zwimela ni fhungudze u elela ha maḓi kha mitalo i re kha vhuimo ha nṱha hu fanaho. Sedzani mavu nga murahu ha mvula ya u thoma khulwane ni ṅwale hune maḓi a elela hone zwa vhukuma.

entries.english: Frost damage to tender crops and young trees
entries.zu: Ukulimala kwezitshalo ezibuthaka nezihlahla ezincane ngenxa yesithwathwa
entries.st: Tshenyo ya serame dijalong tse bobebe le difateng tse nyenyane
entries.ts: Ku onhiwa ka swibyariwa leswi nga tiyelangiki xirhami ni mirhi leyitsongo hi gwitsi
entries.ve: U tshinyala ha zwiliṅwa zwi sa konḓeleli murotholo na miri miṱuku nga murotholo

entries.english: minimum {temperature} °C, below the {threshold} °C threshold
entries.zu: Izinga eliphansi {temperature} °C, ngaphansi komkhawulo ongu-{threshold} °C
entries.st: Bonyane ba {temperature} °C, ka tlase ho moedi wa {threshold} °C
entries.ts: Mahiselo ya le hansi ya {temperature} °C, ehansi ka mpimo wa {threshold} °C
entries.ve: Ṱhukhu ya {temperature} °C, fhasi ha mukano wa {threshold} °C

entries.english: Keep tender crops off the lowest ground, where cold air settles. Plant frost-sensitive trees after the last frost date, not before.
entries.zu: Ungatshali izitshalo ezibuthaka endaweni ephansi kakhulu, lapho kuhlala khona umoya obandayo. Tshala izihlahla ezingakwazi ukumelana nesithwathwa ngemva kosuku lokugcina lwesithwathwa, hhayi ngaphambi kwalo.
entries.st: O se ke wa jala dijalo tse bobebe mobung o tlase ka ho fetisisa, moo moya o batang o dulanang teng. Jala difate tse tshabang serame ka mora letsatsi la ho qetela la serame, eseng pele ho lona.
entries.ts: Papalata ku byala swibyariwa leswi nga tiyelangiki xirhami endhawini ya le hansi ngopfu, laha moya wo titimela wu tshamaka kona. Byala mirhi leyi chavaka gwitsi endzhaku ka siku ro hetelela ra gwitsi, ku nga ri loko ri nga si fika.
entries.ve: Ni songo ṱavha zwiliṅwa zwi sa konḓeleli murotholo fhethu ha fhasi-fhasi, hune muya u rotholelaho wa dzula hone. Ṱavhani miri i sa konḓeleli murotholo nga murahu ha ḓuvha ḽa u fhedza ḽa murotholo, hu si phanḓa haḽo.

entries.english: Soil recommendations are built on modelled soil, not this field
entries.zu: Izincomo zomhlabathi zisekelwe kumodeli yomhlabathi, hhayi kule nsimu
entries.st: Dikeletso tsa mobu di thehilwe mobung wa mohlala, eseng tshimong ena
entries.ts: Switsundzuxo swa misava swi sekeriwe eka misava ya modele, ku nga ri nsimu leyi
entries.ve: Themendelo dza mavu dzo ḓitika nga mavu a modele, hu si tsimu iyi

entries.english: soil figures come from a district-wide model, not a sample taken here
entries.zu: Izibalo zomhlabathi zivela kumodeli yesifunda sonke, hhayi esampuleni ethathwe lapha
entries.st: Dipalo tsa mobu di tswa mohlaleng wa setereke sohle, eseng sampoleng e nkilweng mona
entries.ts: Tinhlayo ta misava ti huma eka modele ya xifundzantsongo hinkwaxo, ku nga ri eka sampulu leyi tekiweke laha
entries.ve: Nomboro dza mavu dzi bva kha modele ya tshiṱiriki tshoṱhe, hu si kha sambula yo dzhiiwaho fhano

entries.english: no soil data for this point — the app's generic defaults were used
entries.zu: Ayikho idatha yomhlabathi yaleli phuzu — kusetshenziswe izibalo ezijwayelekile ze-app
entries.st: Ha ho data ya mobu sebakeng sena — ho sebedisitswe dipalo tse akaretsang tsa app
entries.ts: A ku na datha ya misava ya ndhawu leyi — ku tirhisiwe tinhlayo ta ntolovelo ta app
entries.ve: A hu na data ya mavu kha fhethu hafha — ho shumiswa nomboro dza app dza u angaredza

entries.english: Take one soil sample and send it for a test. It is the cheapest way to replace every estimated soil figure in this report with a measured one.
entries.zu: Thatha isampula elilodwa lomhlabathi ulithumele liyohlolwa. Kuyindlela eshibhe kakhulu yokufaka isilinganiso sangempela esikhundleni saso sonke isibalo somhlabathi esilinganiselwe kulo mbiko.
entries.st: Nka sampole e le nngwe ya mobu mme o e romele bakeng sa teko. Ke mokgwa o theko e tlase ka ho fetisisa wa ho beha palo e lekantsweng sebakeng sa palo e nngwe le e nngwe ya mobu e hakantsweng tlalehong ena.
entries.ts: Teka sampulu yin'we ya misava kutani u yi rhumela ku ya kamberiwa. I ndlela yo chipa ngopfu yo siva nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana ya misava leyi ringanyetiweke eka xiviko lexi hi leyi pimiweke.
entries.ve: Dzhiani sambula nthihi ya mavu ni i rumele kha ndingo. Ndi nḓila ya mutengo wa fhasi u fhira dzoṱhe ya u siva nomboro iṅwe na iṅwe ya mavu yo anganywaho kha muvhigo uyu nga yo pimiwaho.

entries.english: Every area figure is provisional — no property boundary was traced
entries.zu: Zonke izibalo zendawo ngezokuqala — awukho umngcele wendawo odwetshiwe
entries.st: Palo e nngwe le e nngwe ya sebaka ke ya nakwana — ha ho moedi wa sebaka o takilweng
entries.ts: Nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana ya ndhawu i ya xinkarhana — ndzelekano wa ndhawu a wu dirowiwanga
entries.ve: Nomboro iṅwe na iṅwe ya fhethu ndi ya tshifhinganyana — a ho ngo olwa mukano wa fhethu

entries.english: no traced boundary on the map
entries.zu: Awukho umngcele odwetshiwe ebalazweni
entries.st: Ha ho moedi o takilweng mmapeng
entries.ts: A ku na ndzelekano lowu dirowiweke emepeni
entries.ve: A hu na mukano wo olwaho kha mapa

entries.english: Walk and trace the boundary. Until then, treat site area, and anything divided by it, as unconfirmed.
entries.zu: Hamba umngcele uwudwebe. Kuze kube yilapho, thatha indawo yepulazi nanoma yini ehlukaniswa ngayo njengokungaqinisekisiwe.
entries.st: Tsamaya o latele moedi mme o o take. Ho fihlela moo, nka sebaka sa polasi le ntho efe kapa efe e arolwang ka sona e sa netefatswa.
entries.ts: Famba u landzelela ndzelekano kutani u wu dirowa. Ku fikela kwalaho, teka ndhawu ya purasi ni xin'wana ni xin'wana lexi avanyisiwaka hi yona swi nga si tiyisisiwa.
entries.ve: Tshimbilani ni tevhedze mukano ni u ole. U swika zwenezwo, dzhiani vhuhulwane ha fhethu na tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi kovhiwaho ngaho zwi sa athu khwaṱhisedzwa.

entries.english: The build costs more than the bill of quantities shows
entries.zu: Ukwakha kubiza ngaphezu kwalokho okuboniswa uhlu lobuningi
entries.st: Kaho e bitsa ho feta seo lenane la bongata le se bontshang
entries.ts: Ku aka swi durha ku hundza leswi nxaxamelo wa nhlayo wu swi kombaka
entries.ve: U fhaṱa zwi ḓura u fhira zwine mutevhe wa vhunzhi wa sumbedza

entries.ve: Mutalo wa {count} wo pimiwaho kha mutevhe a u na mutengo nga yuniti

entries.ts: Tilayini ta {count} leti pimiweke eka nxaxamelo a ti na nxavo hi yuniti
entries.ve: Mitalo ya {count} yo pimiwaho kha mutevhe a i na mutengo nga yuniti

entries.english: Get local quotes for the unpriced lines before committing a budget. The subtotal in the cost section is a floor, not a total.
entries.zu: Thola amanani endawo emigqeni engenantengo ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ngebhajethi. Isamba esingaphelele esigabeni sezindleko siyisisekelo esiphansi, hhayi isamba sonke.
entries.st: Fumana dikhotheishene tsa lehae bakeng sa mela e se nang theko pele o itlama ka tekanyetso. Kakaretso e sa fellang karolong ya ditshenyehelo ke bonyane, ha se kakaretso yohle.
entries.ts: Kuma mintsengo ya laha kusuhi ya tilayini leti nga riki na nxavo u nga si tiboha eka mpimanyeto. Ntsengo lowu nga helelangiki eka xiyenge xa mali i wa le hansi, a hi ntsengo hinkwawo.
entries.ve: Wanani khotheisheni dza henefho dza mitalo i si na mutengo musi ni sa athu ḓivhofha kha mugaganyagwama. Mutengo u sa athu fhelela kha khethekanyo ya mutengo ndi wa fhasi-fhasi, a si mutengo woṱhe.

entries.english: No crop plan — the growing area has no sowing schedule behind it
entries.zu: Alukho uhlelo lwezitshalo — indawo yokutshala ayinasimiso sokuhlwanyela
entries.st: Ha ho moralo wa dijalo — sebaka sa temo ha se na lenaneo la ho jala
entries.ts: A ku na pulani ya swibyariwa — ndhawu yo byala a yi na xiyimiso xo byala
entries.ve: A hu na pulane ya zwiliṅwa — fhethu ha u ṱavha a hu na mbekanyamushumo ya u zwala

entries.english: nothing entered in the crop planner
entries.zu: Akukho okufakiwe esihleleni sezitshalo
entries.st: Ha ho letho le kentsweng sehlophising sa dijalo
entries.ts: A ku na lexi nghenisiweke eka xipulani xa swibyariwa
entries.ve: A hu na tsho dzheniswaho kha mupulani wa zwiliṅwa

entries.english: Build the crop plan before the next sowing window. Beds without a plan sit empty through the months that matter.
entries.zu: Yakha uhlelo lwezitshalo ngaphambi kwesikhathi esilandelayo sokuhlwanyela. Imibhede engenalo uhlelo ihlala ingenalutho phakathi nezinyanga ezibalulekile.
entries.st: Etsa moralo wa dijalo pele ho nako e latelang ya ho jala. Dibethe tse se nang moralo di dula di se na letho dikgweding tsa bohlokwa.
entries.ts: Endla pulani ya swibyariwa nkarhi lowu landzelaka wo byala wu nga si fika. Mibedo leyi nga riki na pulani yi tshika ku tirhisiwa hi tin'hweti leti nga ta nkoka.
entries.ve: Itani pulane ya zwiliṅwa tshifhinga tshi tevhelaho tsha u zwala tshi sa athu swika. Mibethe i si na pulane i dzula i si na tshithu kha miṅwedzi ya ndeme.

entries.english: Risk Register
entries.zu: Irejista yezingozi
entries.st: Rejista ya dikotsi
entries.ts: Rhejistara ya makhombo
entries.ve: Redzhisiṱara ya khombo

entries.english: No risk in this register's rule set was triggered by this site's data. That is not the same as no risk — it means the specific thresholds this report checks (rainfall, slope, frost, soil basis, traced boundary, unpriced work, crop plan) were all clear.
entries.zu: Idatha yale ndawo ayivusanga ngozi emithethweni yale rejista. Lokhu akusho ukuthi ayikho ingozi — kusho ukuthi imikhawulo ethile ehlolwa yilo mbiko (imvula, ukwehla, isithwathwa, isisekelo somhlabathi, umngcele odwetshiwe, umsebenzi ongenantengo, uhlelo lwezitshalo) ayivusanga sixwayiso.
entries.st: Data ya sebaka sena ha e a tsosa kotsi melaong ya rejista ena. Seo ha se bolele hore ha ho kotsi — se bolela hore meedi e itseng e hlahlojwang ke tlaleho ena (pula, moepa, serame, motheo wa mobu, moedi o takilweng, mosebetsi o se nang theko, moralo wa dijalo) ha e a tsosa temoso.
entries.ts: Datha ya ndhawu leyi a yi pfuxanga khombo eka milawu ya rhejistara leyi. Sweswo a swi vuli leswaku a ku na khombo — swi vula leswaku mimpimo yo karhi leyi xiviko lexi xi yi kambelaka (mpfula, ku rhelela, gwitsi, masungulo ya misava, ndzelekano lowu dirowiweke, mitirho leyi nga riki na nxavo, pulani ya swibyariwa) a yi pfuxanga xitsundzuxo.
entries.ve: Data ya fhethu hafha a yo ngo vusa khombo kha milayo ya redzhisiṱara iyi. Zwenezwo a zwi ambi uri a hu na khombo — zwi amba uri mikano yo livhaho ine muvhigo uyu wa i sedza (mvula, mutsheṱo, murotholo, mutheo wa mavu, mukano wo olwaho, mushumo u si na mutengo, pulane ya zwiliṅwa) a yo ngo vusa tsevho.

entries.english: Each row was raised by this site's own data. The trigger column prints the figure and the threshold that produced the rating, so a reader who disagrees can argue with the number rather than the adjective.
entries.zu: Umugqa ngamunye uvela kudatha yale ndawo uqobo. Ikholomu yesizathu iveza isibalo nomkhawulo okudale isilinganiso, ukuze umfundi ongavumelani naso akhulume ngenombolo kunegama lokuchaza.
entries.st: Mola ka mong o hlahisitswe ke data ya sebaka sena. Kholomo ya sesosa e bontsha palo le moedi tse hlahisitseng tekanyo, hore mmadi ya sa dumellaneng a bue ka palo ho e na le lentswe le hlalosang.
entries.ts: Layini yin'wana ni yin'wana yi pfuxiwe hi datha ya ndhawu leyi. Kholomu ya xivangelo yi komba nhlayo ni mpimo leswi vangeke mpimo wa khombo, leswaku muhlayi loyi a nga pfumelelaniki a nga kaneta nhlayo ematshan'weni ya rito ro hlamusela.
entries.ve: Mutalo muṅwe na muṅwe wo bveledzwa nga data ya fhethu hafha. Kholomu ya tshivhangi i sumbedza nomboro na mukano zwo bveledzaho ndeme, uri muvhali a sa tendelani nazwo a kone u amba nga nomboro nṱhani ha ipfi ḽa u ṱalusa.
